$description: User-facing copy of the iOS and Android apps. Each key holds English (the default) and Simplified Chinese. Placeholders are {name}. pnpm mobile:strings writes the platform catalogs.

keyboard.dictate.comment: Accessibility name of the microphone button.

keyboard.done.comment: Accessibility name of the microphone button while listening.

failure.fullAccess.en: Turn on Allow Full Access for Arion in Settings › General › Keyboard › Keyboards.
failure.fullAccess.zh-Hans: 请在“设置 › 通用 › 键盘 › 键盘”中为 Arion 打开“允许完全访问”。

failure.microphone.en: Open Arion to allow the microphone.
failure.microphone.zh-Hans: 请打开 Arion 允许使用麦克风。

failure.language.en: This language can’t be dictated on this device.
failure.language.zh-Hans: 此设备无法听写这种语言。

failure.installing.en: Downloading the speech model. Try again in a moment.
failure.installing.zh-Hans: 正在下载语音模型，请稍后再试。

failure.capture.en: The microphone stopped. Another app may be using it.
failure.capture.zh-Hans: 麦克风已停止，可能有其他应用正在使用。

onboarding.welcome.body.en: Arion turns your voice into clean text in any app. Speech is recognized and polished on this device.
onboarding.welcome.body.zh-Hans: Arion 在任何应用里把语音变成干净的文字。识别和润色都在这台设备上完成。

onboarding.microphone.body.en: Arion listens only while you dictate.
onboarding.microphone.body.zh-Hans: Arion 只在你听写时收音。

onboarding.microphone.denied.en: The microphone is off for Arion. Turn it on in Settings.
onboarding.microphone.denied.zh-Hans: Arion 的麦克风权限已关闭，请在“设置”中打开。

onboarding.keyboard.fullAccessNote.en: Full Access lets the keyboard use the microphone. Nothing you type or say leaves this device.
onboarding.keyboard.fullAccessNote.zh-Hans: 完全访问让键盘可以使用麦克风。你输入和说出的内容都不会离开这台设备。

onboarding.try.body.en: Switch to Arion with the globe key, tap the microphone and speak.
onboarding.try.body.zh-Hans: 用地球键切换到 Arion，点按麦克风后说话。

onboarding.try.placeholder.zh-Hans: 你说的话会出现在这里

settings.languages.footer.en: With more than one, tap the language key to switch.
settings.languages.footer.zh-Hans: 选择多种语言时，点按语言键切换。

settings.translate.footer.en: While dictating, tap the translate key to insert a translation instead.
settings.translate.footer.zh-Hans: 听写时点按翻译键，插入译文。

settings.polish.footer.en: Fixes punctuation, slips and repeated words with the on-device model. Your meaning and voice stay.
settings.polish.footer.zh-Hans: 用设备上的模型修正标点、口误和重复，保留你的意思和语气。

settings.polish.turnedOff.en: Turn on Apple Intelligence in Settings to polish.
settings.polish.turnedOff.zh-Hans: 在“设置”中打开 Apple 智能后即可润色。

settings.polish.unsupported.en: This iPhone can’t run the on-device model. Text is inserted as recognized.
settings.polish.unsupported.zh-Hans: 这台 iPhone 无法运行设备上的模型，文字将按识别结果插入。

settings.polish.preparing.en: The on-device model is getting ready.
settings.polish.preparing.zh-Hans: 设备上的模型正在准备。

settings.polish.androidUnavailable.en: This phone has no on-device model for polishing. Text is inserted as recognized.
settings.polish.androidUnavailable.zh-Hans: 这台手机没有可用于润色的设备端模型，文字将按识别结果插入。

settings.vocabulary.footer.en: Names and terms you add are recognized and kept as written.
settings.vocabulary.footer.zh-Hans: 添加的人名和术语会被识别，并按原样保留。

settings.history.footer.en: Keeps your last 100 dictations on this device. Turning it off erases them.
settings.history.footer.zh-Hans: 在这台设备上保留最近 100 条听写。关闭后会清除。

android.onboarding.enable.body.en: Turn on Arion Voice in the list of keyboards.
android.onboarding.enable.body.zh-Hans: 在键盘列表中打开 Arion 语音。

android.onboarding.select.body.en: Choose Arion Voice as the keyboard you’re using.
android.onboarding.select.body.zh-Hans: 将 Arion 语音设为当前使用的键盘。

android.onboarding.enable.note.en: Android shows a notice for every keyboard you turn on. Arion keeps what you type and say on this phone.
android.onboarding.enable.note.zh-Hans: 启用任何键盘时，Android 都会显示提醒。Arion 会把你输入和说出的内容保留在这台手机上。

android.failure.recognizer.en: This phone has no on-device speech recognizer.
android.failure.recognizer.zh-Hans: 这台手机没有设备端语音识别。

android.failure.microphone.en: Open Arion to allow the microphone.
android.failure.microphone.zh-Hans: 请打开 Arion 允许使用麦克风。

android.failure.busy.en: The recognizer is busy. Try again.

android.failure.network.en: The speech model for this language isn’t on this phone yet.
android.failure.network.zh-Hans: 这台手机还没有该语言的语音模型。
